title: DAILY FIGHTER — FOUNDATION WEEK 3 DAY 15
emphasis: Thursday LOWER STRESS: body control, easy rings, hip hinge, rotational control, elastic contacts and mobility. Current shoulder status unknown; keep every movement pain-free.

levels.standard: 44:55 complete: Ignition + A×3/B×3/C×3/D×2/E×4. Work, setup, side switches and prescribed rest included.
levels.bonus: Optional 5:00 easy walking. BJJ option: Ignition + A×2/E×2 (19:00), or skip physical workout if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Jump Rope — Basic Bounce
ignition.prescription: 10:00 continuous clock: 20 sec easy rope + 40 sec easy walk ×10
ignition.reps: 10 rounds: 20 sec easy basic bounce / 40 sec walk
ignition.home: Jump rope: basic bounce 20 sec / easy walk 40 sec ×10
ignition.away: Brisk outdoor walk 20 sec / easy walk 40 sec ×10
ignition.cue: RPE 3; small quiet bounces; easy breathing; use AWAY if rope is uncomfortable.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: PLANCHE BODYLINE FOUNDATION
deposits.effort: Rest 0:45 after each round. RPE 4–5 / ≥5 RIR. Rung: bent-knee bodyline foundation; last qualifying confirmed exposure: none. Today: establish baseline only. Next: 3×15–20 sec clean on two confirmed exposures; this does not unlock loaded planche work.

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Hollow Hold
exercises.cue: Bodyline foundation; no planche gate credit. Knees bent, arms by sides, low back down.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cue: Slow opposite arm/leg reach in a comfortable range; low back stays down.

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: EASY RINGS + INCLINE PRESS
deposits.effort: Rest 0:40 after each round. RPE 5 / ≥5 RIR. Rungs: very upright ring row + hip-height incline press; last qualifying confirmed exposure: none. Today: repeat row, establish press baseline. Next: two confirmed clean 3×6–8 exposures at 2–3 RIR and ≤RPE 8 before leverage changes.

exercises.name: Ring Row
exercises.cue: Very upright, easy leverage; no dead hang. Stop for shoulder or radiating symptoms.

exercises.name: Hip-Height Incline Push-Up
exercises.cue: Use only a pain-free arc; keep ribs stacked; wall regression if needed.

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: HIP HINGE + ROTATIONAL CONTROL
deposits.effort: Rest 0:40 after each round. RPE 5 / ≥5 RIR; choose light loads and record actual pounds. Rungs: basic KB hinge + light standing rotation; last qualifying confirmed exposure: none. Today: baseline only. Next: two confirmed clean 3×6–8 exposures at 2–3 RIR and ≤RPE 8; advance one variable.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
exercises.cue: Choose a light load for RPE 5 / at least 5 RIR; log actual load after completion.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Rotation
exercises.home: Functional trainer: light standing cable rotation
exercises.away: Unloaded standing rotation with hip pivot
exercises.cue: Light control practice, RPE 5; pivot feet with hips; no forced shoulder range.

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: ELASTIC POWER MECHANICS
deposits.effort: Rest 0:40 after each round. RPE 4; stop before fatigue. Rehearse elastic contacts; no height or speed target increase.

exercises.name: Pogo Hop
exercises.cue: Low amplitude, quiet quick contacts; stop if rhythm or landing changes.

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: HIP MOBILITY + CARRY
deposits.effort: Rest 0:15 after each round. Easy breathing / RPE 3–5; ≥5 RIR where relevant. 9:40 total mobility + carry. Controlled hip range, comfortable light loads; no progression today.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
exercises.cue: Use hands for support as needed; move hips gently; no knee pinching.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.away: Two equally loaded bags: farmer carry
exercises.cue: RPE 4–5; tall posture, quiet steps; loads must feel comfortable at the shoulder.

martialSupplement.name: Hip Escape
martialSupplement.cue: Separate optional BJJ practice. Rest within each minute; no forced shoulder pressure; never auto-log.
